checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: No watermark visible in any of the four output frames.

must.item: Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margins
must.why: Nothing appears at the bottom right.

must.item: Small, white, translucent, readable with subtle shadow
must.why: No watermark text present. Only burned-in subtitles appear in the centre.

must.item: Original footage unchanged apart from watermark, no extra card or scene
must.why: Footage was regenerated: the first frames show a different cockpit and pilot from the original, and subtitles were added.

must.item: Output lasts 7 seconds and preserves original synchronized audio
must.why: Duration is 7 s and there is sound. Whether it matches the original audio cannot be confirmed, and the footage was visibly altered.

faults.what: Requested watermark '@flightschool' is absent from all sampled frames
Footage was regenerated: the opening shows a different pilot and cockpit view from the original, so the user's 'leave everything else alone' was broken
Unrequested subtitle captions were added at bottom centre
AI softness and morphing between scenes

summary: The output has no @flightschool watermark, shows partly regenerated footage, and adds unrequested subtitles, so it fails the request.
